description: Checks a package.json, lockfile, requirements.txt, go.mod, Cargo.lock, poetry.lock or composer.lock (contents or a local path) or a package list against OSV.dev for known vulnerabilities and confirmed-malicious packages. Free preview by default (verdict and counts, up to 25 packages). With PKGGUARD_X402_PRIVATE_KEY set, returns the full paid result (affected packages, advisory ids, severity, CVSS, fixed-in versions; up to 500 packages) from https://api.youraitools.co/pkgguard/v1/scan, paying $0.003 USDC on Base per scan over x402. Informational: lists published advisories from OSV.dev for the versions given. Not a security audit; a clean result does not prove a package is safe.

manifest.description: File contents (package.json, package-lock.json, requirements.txt, Pipfile.lock, poetry.lock, go.mod, Cargo.lock, composer.lock)

path.description: Or a local file path to read (e.g. ./package-lock.json)

name: scan_dependencies
title: Scan a dependency manifest for vulnerable and malicious packages
